The Chinese characters for Christina

Origin and meaning

With Greek origins, Christina is usually read as “follower of Christ”.

About the name Christina

A form of Christine, tied to the word 'Christ'.

As a gift or a tattoo

If you are choosing a name for a print or a tattoo, Christina carries the meaning “follower of Christ” and looks striking in brush strokes.
